text_block_list.text:
Though she ran a great race, Sakura 
Chiyono O felt completely exhausted. 
Meanwhile, Bamboo Memory energetically 
declared right after the race that she was 
ready for another.

At that moment, it felt as though 
something had begun to crack and crumble. 
Compared to an "Umamusume with a future," 
it felt as if something was slowly rotting 
away...

Meanwhile, Maruzensky was steadily 
improving. Even if she couldn't return to 
her peak... she possessed a strength born 
from her desire to run with all her might 
right now.

The Japan Cup they promised to run 
together is fast approaching. Sakura 
Chiyono O proposes running in a different 
GⅠ before then.

And so, her next goal was set on the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn). She also added that she 
didn't want the current situation shared 
with others, and that she'd be just 
fine...
